items.title: Expeditors (EXPD) Stock May Be Fairly Valued As AI Demand Builds
items.summary: Expeditors International of Washington has delivered a powerful run over the past few years, helped by steady demand for its freight and logistics services. items.title: Ryanair's Traffic Numbers for October 2026 Improve Year Over Year
items.summary: RYAAY's October 2026 traffic rose 1% to 19.4 million passengers, with a steady 93% load factor, as the carrier targets 3% traffic growth in fiscal 2027.

items.title: EXPD Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Airfreight and Ocean Strength
items.summary: Expeditors' Q3 earnings surge 61.6%, beating estimates as strong airfreight demand, rebounding ocean volumes and customs growth lifted revenues and margins.

items.title: Expeditors (NYSE:EXPD) delivers impressive Q3 2026
items.summary: Logistics and freight forwarding company Expeditors (NYSE:EXPD) reported Q3 2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with revenue up 41.9% year on year to $4.11 billion. Its GAAP profit of $2.65 per share was 18.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
